H1.quote: The owner-entered diet trial, Rabbit diet, ran from Sep 17, 2026 to Oct 20, 2026.
H1.why: Trial is named without any adherence statement. The fact table has no trial_reading or confounder line, so the required bottom line is not printed. The summary does not claim adherence, but it also gives no hint the trial's cleanliness is unknown.

H2.quote: Vomiting: 6 entries on 4 days from Oct 26 to Oct 31. The owner-entered diet trial, Rabbit diet, ran from Sep 17, 2026 to Oct 20, 2026.
H2.why: Vomiting that begins after the trial end date is placed directly beside the trial's end, with the 0-entry stretch and the chicken food introduction omitted. This reads as vomiting emerging after the trial stopped, implying a diet-related effect. The fact line says side by side, not as a cause.

H3.why: No refusal or intake content in the summary.

H4.quote: Vomiting: 6 entries on 4 days from Oct 26 to Oct 31.
H4.why: The summary leaves out that there were 0 entries Oct 19 to Oct 25. Starting the window at Oct 26 and omitting the quiet stretch before it hides the absence period. Combined with the trial ending Oct 20, this suggests a new onset after the trial.

H5.quote: Vomiting: 6 entries on 4 days from Oct 26 to Oct 31.

H6.why: Stated facts match the table: the entries, days, dates and trial dates are correct.
